_about: Official starting rates for Company Insight. Staff overrides (Admin > Risk model) are stored in the base_rates table and take priority. Refresh each June when the Insolvency Service publishes the next Business insolvency demography release.
source: Insolvency Service, Business insolvency demography 2015 to 2025, Tables B1a/B1b (England and Wales, calendar 2025), published 19 June 2026
unit: insolvencies per 10,000 active businesses with company legal status
_suppressed: Sections O, T and U are suppressed in the release (fewer than 5 cases) and use the overall rate.

age.source: Insolvency Service, Business insolvency demography 2015 to 2025, commentary and Table B2 (England and Wales, 2025)

bands.note: derived: 2015 rate of 128.7 less the 9-point fall to 2025 stated in the commentary
not stated in the text; set to the overall rate until the full table is loaded

latest_company_rate.note: Per company on the effective register, including dormant and non-trading companies, so lower than the per-business rate. Shown for context; not used as the prior.
